title: HeartLoss
body:
# 💔 HeartLoss Plugin
HeartLoss is a configurable Minecraft plugin that introduces a hardcore-style mechanic:
Every time a player dies, they permanently lose 1 heart (2 HP) — unless they recover it using a configurable item like a Golden Apple.

# 🧩 Features

- ✅ Lose 1 heart on death
- ✅ Restore hearts by using a configurable item (e.g. minecraft:golden_apple)
- ✅ Broadcasts a chat and title message when a player dies
- ✅ Everything customizable via config.yml
- ✅ Supports [EssentialX Spawn](https://modrinth.com/plugin/essentialsx-spawn), [LuckyPerms](https://modrinth.com/plugin/luckperms), [TAB](https://modrinth.com/plugin/tab-was-taken)


# 💬 Admin Commands

Command Description
1. /heartloss setmessage <message>	Set the chat message shown on death
2. /heartloss setitem <minecraft:item>	Change the restore item
3. /heartloss settitle main <message>	Set the center-screen title
4. /heartloss settitle subtitle <message>	Set the center-screen subtitle
5. /heartloss reload	Reload the config file
6. /heartloss help	Show all available commands
   


🔒 Requires permission: heartloss.admin
